[SWS_DM_01080] Security level check for DDID
⌈
On reception of ser-
vice ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction ’defineByIdentifier’, the DM shall
check if the DDDID can be defined in the security level according to [SWS_DM_00414].
If the DDID cannot be defined in the current security level, the DM shall return an NRC
0x31 (requestOutOfRange).
⌋
